decisions.opt_in: iommu.research=1 (default false); exact KBUILD_MODNAME=iommu verified from saved existing compiler command
decisions.endpoint_transition: one driver-wide domain-transition mutex -> old/new domain locks -> endpoint lock; list_del_init old membership only after successful IODIR post; no list mutation on allocation/post failure; restore saved context fields on failed post
decisions.blocked_domain: TC.V=0, no allocated translation root or identifier
decisions.borrowed_root: unmanaged private research domain, current mm only, plain Sv39, mmget/mmput; no io-pgtable ops; map returns EPERM/unmap returns0; borrowed PGD never freed
decisions.ordinary_identifiers: upper-half PSCIDs [2^19,2^20-1], independent GSCID [1,65535]; pre-attach failure reclaimed; research restoration certificate permits reuse; attached ordinary domains without certificate preserve old identifier-lease leak while freeing detached object/root under original contract; host VMA certificate never reclaims attached GSCID
decisions.PASID_behavior_change: PD20 IOMMU advertised max_pasids capped to 2^19, endpoint pasid_bits capped consistently; inherited PASID >=2^19 rejected; max_pasids0 PCI endpoints not enabled; existing unrelated generic PASID SVA limitations remain
decisions.CQ_bundle: IODIR(DV1,DID10), IODIR(DV1,DID11), host VMA(GV/AV/PSCV0), AV marker fresh32bit zeroextended64bit token, noAV sentinel; N>=8 power2, five free slots and one ring gap; actual global producer ledger modulo matches CQT; final exact CQH==bundle_end plus whole64 token and no CQ error/reset/base/tail drift
decisions.CQ_history: cq_lock gate excludes all ordinary posts and IRQ clearing across entire bundle; blocked unexpected poster increments error generation so certificate cannot silently pass; post-publication failure poisons queue permanently and retains marker; no retry/reset API
decisions.marker_visibility: one dedicated page per IOMMU, 8-byte aligned isolated physical marker; caller-provided synchronous full-cache publication/acquisition hook before CQT and each whole64 read; never infer hardware coherence from allocator naming
decisions.safe_release: research domain still attached or without later successful restoration epoch cannot be freed/mmput; checked release returns error without dropping resources
decisions.removal: normal clean CQ-off removal frees dedicated marker; active/poisoned CQ removal refuses local teardown; hot-unplug/abort recovery is not implemented or accepted

runtime_limits: No native ioctl, DMA, FPGA, board or time result; no Image built by this child.
Caller must independently establish all-source/TL/PTW/result/spill and read/write/response quiescence before certificate; IOFENCE PR/PW support is absent and not claimed.
Caller owns pinning, mmap_read_lock over synchronous episode through drain+restore, all payload validation and late fault checks.
No generic SVA/notifier/demand-paging, arbitrary asynchronous memory use, hotplug or bounded hardware failure recovery claim.
If post-publication certificate fails, root must retain domain/mm/pages/owner and prevent borrowed page-table teardown; timeout never authorizes mm-put/unpin.
